about.label: About Titan
about.title: Born during a pandemic. Launched in Africa.
about.p1: While the world stood still during COVID-19, Titan Engenharia took off with bold projects across Africa. Founded in 2021 by Marlon de Mendonça, a civil engineer graduated from the Pontifical Catholic University in 1998, specialized in non-ferrous metals metallurgy.
about.p2: We serve mining clients in Uganda, Congo, Nigeria, Namibia, Venezuela, Bolivia, and Brazil. Our specialty covers non-ferrous metals — tin, gold, lead, zinc, tantalum, niobium — from feasibility studies to full plant operation.
about.p3: Ethics, integrity, and bold innovation guide every technical decision. We don't deliver projects — we deliver working plants.
about.mission: To guide metallurgical projects from concept to full operation, providing consulting, training, and integrated solutions for productivity, safety, and sustainability.
about.vision: To be a global reference in non-ferrous metals, leading sustainable innovations in international projects.
